caseName: Bargaintown, U. S. A., Inc. v. Whitman
caseNameFull: BARGAINTOWN, U. S. A., INC. v. WHITMAN, DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF LEBANON COUNTY, PA.
attorneys: David G. Bress and Leonard Braman for appellants., Anne X. Alpern, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, and Harry J. Rubin for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed. McGowan v. Maryland, 366 U. S. 420, and Two Guys from Harrison-Allentown, Inc., v. McGinley, 366 U. S. 582.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
